goal: Implement Cloud Auto Trader Pro 24/7 Engine in Render Worker: Autonomous Loop, Supabase Session Bus, Market Breakout Entry, Dynamic Risk Management (Break-Even, Trailing Stop, TP/SL), and Telegram Attribution Pipeline
execution_steps: Write test in test_auto_trader_cloud.py verifying session CRUD and breakout evaluation loop
Run pytest test_auto_trader_cloud.py to verify red phase
Update supabase_schema_v2.sql to define auto_trader_sessions table with status index and RLS
Implement session persistence methods in supabase_client.py: upsert_auto_trader_session, get_active_auto_trader_sessions, update_auto_trader_session
Implement autonomous cloud trading cycle inside telegram_bot.py under the Render worker thread
Integrate breakout signal detection, paper trade execution, break-even (+0.8%), trailing stop, take profit (+2.0%), and stop loss (-2.0%)
Connect Telegram alerts and Web Push notifications upon cloud trade entry and exit with user attribution
Run pytest test_auto_trader_cloud.py to verify green phase
acceptance_criteria: auto_trader_sessions DDL is defined in supabase_schema_v2.sql with user_id, status, capital, and position JSON
supabase_client.py provides deterministic CRUD methods for auto_trader_sessions with automatic retry
telegram_bot.py runs the cloud auto trader cycle every 10 seconds in the background worker thread
Worker detects breakouts on Binance live tickers and executes paper entry, updating session in Supabase
Worker tracks open position and triggers Break-Even, Trailing Stop, Take Profit (+2%), and Stop Loss (-2%)
Closing position credits user balance and sends Telegram alert with user display name attribution
All tests in test_auto_trader_cloud.py pass with exit code 0
definition_of_done: No pre-existing bot_engine or telegram alerts are broken or regressed

rollback.command: git checkout HEAD -- supabase_schema_v2.sql supabase_client.py telegram_bot.py; rm -f test_auto_trader_cloud.py contracts/TSK-AUTOTRADER-012.contract.json
